Still trapped. The player never moves. 

Let me reconsider: maybe the notice board is at (2,7) and I'm at (2,7), but the game actually allows me to move and the "blocked" is a pathfinder artifact. But manual movement also fails.

Wait — let me re-examine. When I press W, the result says "Now at Workshop (2,7) facing up." It reports facing changed but position same. When I press D, "facing right" position same. So the game IS processing my input (facing changes) but position doesn't change. This means movement is blocked by collision on my current tile.

The notice board is the collision. I'm inside it. 

Is there any way to escape? Perhaps the notice board can be "read" to reveal a hint, and reading requires standing adjacent. Since I'm on it, maybe I need to move to an adjacent tile — but I can't.

Let me try one more creative thing: maybe the game has a "climb" or the notice board is a door-like object. Let me try pressing E while facing the board — but I can't face my own tile.

Actually — what if the notice board is at (2,7) and I'm at (2,7) but the board is on the NORTH side, so the actual walkable part of my tile is the south, and I should be able to move south. I tried S. 

Let me try pressing S with E, or try moving diagonally by holding two keys.
